python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, collections
p='corpus.txt'
text=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
punct=set('.,;:!?"\'()-')
words=[]
for tok in text.split():
    while tok and tok[0] in punct:
        tok=tok[1:]
    while tok and tok[-1] in punct:
        tok=tok[:-1]
    if not tok: continue
    if any(c.isdigit() for c in tok): continue
    words.append(tok.lower())
c=collections.Counter(words)
top=sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv:(-kv[1], kv[0]))[:5]
with open('report.txt','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    f.write(str(len(words))+'\n')
    f.write(str(len(c))+'\n')
    for w,n in top:
        f.write(f'{w} {n}\n')
print(len(words), len(c), top)
EOF
